parameters.name: IsCanary
parameters.description:
The type of the Istio Pilot with which you want to associate the EIPs. Valid values:

*   `true`: Bind an EIP to the Istio Pilot during canary release (only valid during the canary release).
*   `false`: Bind an EIP to the Istio Pilot in stable state.

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description:
The type of the operation that you want to perform. Valid values:

*   `UnBindEip`: unbinds an elastic IP address (EIP) from the Istio Pilot.
*   `BindEip`: binds an EIP to the Istio Pilot.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh modify-pilot-eip-resource --service-mesh-id c1f5a67154bec40629c2698ec00000000 --operation BindEip --eip-id eip-hp36jpqq5eged00000000 --is-canary false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh ModifyPilotEipResource --region cn-hangzhou --IsCanary false --ServiceMeshId c1f5a67154bec40629c2698ec00000000 --EipId 'eip-hp36jpqq5eged00000000' --Operation BindEip
